packageRules.description: Automerge patch/minor docker image and Helm chart bumps once they are 3 days old. ignoreTests makes automerge skip status checks, so the delay holds only because strict internalChecksFilter keeps the branch from being created; releases without a timestamp (any registry but Docker Hub) wait on the Dependency Dashboard for a manual unpend rather than skipping the delay
Pin images in values.yaml to tag@digest; the helm-values manager defaults pinDigests to false, so it must be set in a package rule
Never automerge major docker image or Helm chart bumps
Bump the dashboard's Bun image and tool pin together, and never automerge: its checks run locally (bun run verify)
